300.body: Nigeria Eyes Polish Investment To Reduce Fish Imports, Boost Local Production Nigeria By Chris UGWU On Nov 25, 2026 Dr. Adegboyega Oyetola The Federal Government is seeking to attract Polish investment, modern technology and technical expertise into Nigeria’s fisheries and aquaculture sectors as part of efforts to increase domestic fish production, reduce import dependence and strengthen food security. Under the terms of the contract, which began this week, UNI-FLY will transport construction and commissioning personnel to and from the Baltica 2 site, one of the largest offshore wind projects under construction in the Baltic Sea.
400.body: UNI-FLY has announced a contract to provide crew change support to the 1.5 GW offshore wind farm Baltica 2 currently under construction in the Polish sector of the Baltic Sea. Under the terms of the contract, which began this week, UNI-FLY will transport construction and commissioning personnel to and from the Baltica 2 site, one of the largest offshore wind projects under construction in the Baltic Sea. The base will serve as the hub for daily crew change flights and support flight operations, engineering, and ground support teams for the duration of the contract. The arrival of the AW139 IGW will expand payload and range, supporting heavier crew rotations and equipment transfers as construction activity on the wind farm scales up.

500.body: MemTensor, a Shanghai-based AI company, announced the release of MemT-1.0-Pro late Monday, but its own technical report shows the model's built-in memory scoring 19 points below MemTensor's text-based MemOS system on the same NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra backbone, according to i10X News analysis of the report and XiaoHu.AI's report breakdown. Developers deciding whether memory inside a model can replace retrieval for long-running AI agents now have a 554-billion-parameter test case, along with a license split, a September compromise of MemTensor's software packages and Chinese state-cooperation laws to check before adopting it.MemT-1.0-Pro is the third and largest model in MemTensor's MemT-1.0 family, following the Nano and Flash models released in October.

500.body: Meta and Amazon are reportedly in ongoing negotiations over a potential partnership that would connect Meta’s popular Muse AI agent to Amazon’s online store, a deal that would end a two-month blockade imposed by the e-commerce giant on the shopping bot. In theory, an AI agent like Muse could bypass the sponsored listings and advertisements on Amazon’s website, which is a massive business worth $68.6 billion, or nearly 10% of Amazon’s total annual revenue. Amazon is concerned about the quality of product search results Muse would display to shoppers.Thirdly, executives worry that automated shopping bots will come between Amazon and its customers, weakening the direct relationship the retailer has built with consumers.
